Both landed (4b53012d, 8c70cff0). The physics completeness audit (0901138a, section 4.c) further found that the sealed variant used the v1.4 ISOTROPIC redirect, which also randomises v_parallel, whereas Brandt et al. 2016 rotate only the perpendicular velocity - so the sealed run was a bracket of the reference's model, not the model; model v2.1.0 (cft_revival.pic2d.sensitivity, tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_v210_anomalous_transport.py) implements the reference's event (bohm_perpendicular_rotation) and verifies D_perp = (kT_e/eB) alpha/(1+alpha^2) on both backends. For a code-to-code comparison the reference's own model is the right closure to seal; alpha stays 0.4 (nu_an = 0.4 omega_ce: the D_perp coefficient read as a rate, the natural mapping of a selection probability that depends on |B| only, Pb_237; exact Green-Kubo factor 0.345 disclosed as before).

anomalous_collisions.alpha_note: model v2.1.0 Bohm-type anomalous transport with the reference's event model (Brandt et al. 2016, Pb_237): every electron has its velocity rotated about the local B by a uniform random angle - v_parallel and |v| unchanged to round-off, gyro-centre shifted - with probability 1 - exp(-alpha omega_ce dt) per step at the particle's |B|; nu_an = 0.4 omega_ce = the reference's D_perp = 0.4 k T_e / e B read as a rate (a selection probability that depends on |B| only, as the reference describes); exact Green-Kubo D_perp = (k T_e / e B) alpha / (1 + alpha^2) = 0.345 k T_e / e B (verified on both backends, tests/pic2d/test_pic2d_v210_anomalous_transport.py). At 0.7 T nu_an = 4.92e+10 s^-1, nu_an dt = 0.034. Elastic (no ledger energy term), count tallied (cumulative.anomalous), axial momentum in pz_collisions; outside the MCC null-collision budget as a separate exact-Poisson process (amendment 1)

reference.citation: Brandt, T., Schneider, R., Duras, J., Kahnfeld, D., Hey, F. G., Kersten, H., Jansen, F., Braxmaier, C. (2016). Particle-in-Cell Simulation of a Down-Scaled HEMP Thruster. Trans. JSASS Aerospace Tech. Japan 14(ists30), Pb_235-Pb_242.
reference.role: published PIC-MCC model output (code-to-code); not hardware

simplifications: no ion-neutral collisions (elastic or charge exchange)
electron-neutral: isotropic elastic without the 2 m_e/M energy loss, one lumped 8.32 eV excitation, single ionisation with Vahedi-Surendra secondary energy and isotropic emission
dielectric wall: perfectly absorbing with accumulated surface charge, zero field in the dielectric backing (perfect insulator), no secondary electron emission, no sputtering
exit plane: Dirichlet 0 V cathode/neutraliser reference; electrons injected there as a flux-weighted half-Maxwellian at fixed current
anode: perfectly absorbing conductor at fixed potential
cone wall represented as a one-cell stair-step of the plasma cell mask
prescribed static B from the P2 solution (no plasma-induced field); bilinear node interpolation of the C1 bicubic psi field
ions pushed every 8 steps with 8 dt (frozen in between; births added to the ion charge immediately)
electrostatic only, azimuthally symmetric: no azimuthal instabilities/anomalous transport
momentum-conserving bilinear scheme: energy is not exactly conserved; the ledger (with electrode work) residual is reported; a resume restarts the interval ledger
development/screening run: not preregistered, no experimental validation, not a performance prediction
neutrals: STATIC uniform xenon background 2e20 m^-3 at 500 K (the reference's static DSMC mean); no depletion, no profile (the reference's drops 6e20 -> 1e20 along the channel)
electron source: 1.8 mA / 1 eV at the 0 V exit plane = the reference's continuity-derived effective source (an input taken from its results)
channel-only box: the reference's 6.48 mm plume, its grounded body and its 0 V far boundaries are replaced by the Dirichlet exit plane (approximation A9); plume rows not compared

Bohm-type anomalous transport with the reference's perpendicular-rotation event model at nu_an = 0.4 omega_ce (D_perp = 0.345 k T_e / e B exact) - the reference's coefficient and event model, IMPOSED as a constant-alpha closure as the reference does; no SEE versus its 50 % / 90 % model
reconstructed field: level-0 material-aware P2 of the thesis' magnet stack with approximations A1-A8, scaled to the published axis anchor; not P2-qualified
one grid (the published 20 um) and one seed: the grid caveat is carried, not measured; the 15 um sibling and a seed replicate are the declared follow-ups

one preregistered execution on one of four CUDA-MPS slots of a shared H100 (the design mini-sweep runs beside it): a code-to-code comparison of two development models, not a validation against hardware

acceptance.a_plateau: stop_reason == plateau_reached_after_min_transit_times under stopping_rule.plateau (>= 3 x 1.40 us, drifts of I_d and N_e < 5 %, triad soft, peak-Debye soft 2.5)
acceptance.c_comparison: every row of comparison-spec.json with comparable_under containing 'channel' evaluated with S from the trailing window (E, u_val, statement); rows needing the plume box are reported as not comparable

d_verdicts.comparison_quotable: (a) AND (b): E +- u_val per row is quotable as CROSS-MODEL agreement/disagreement under the declared closure differences
d_verdicts.comparison_resolution_flagged: (a) fails ONLY on the peak-Debye soft precondition (plateau drifts met, peak between 2.5 and pi) AND (b): E reported with 'resolution margin not met' on every row
d_verdicts.no_plateau: NOT (a) otherwise: inconclusive within the budget; the trailing-window quantities are reported as transient
d_verdicts.plateau_with_heating: (a) but NOT (b): E reported, not quotable

acceptance.declared: predeclared in this DRAFT; evaluated by `run.py assess` and `run.py compare` on the trailing-window quantities
acceptance.e_claim_ceiling: CROSS_MODEL_AGREEMENT: a published model output can support cross-model agreement at most; nothing here opens GATE-L3 or validates against hardware

stopping_rule.fail_closed: runtime omega_pe dt gate (0.2), v2.0.3 window-mode peak-node Debye gate (hard pi cells per lambda_D on the 400000-step interval-averaged peak, once the window is complete), grid-heating triad hard drift bounds (S, T_e,dense, omega_pe dt drifts >= 0.25 after one transit) and the v2.0.3 windowed residual-power bound (trailing-400000-step ledger residual >= 5 % of the electrode work, one-sided, from the first complete window), one-cell Courant crossing, Poisson residual contract, neutral inventory exhaustion or ceiling violation: PIC2DStabilityError / triad stop ends the run with the artifacts written

grid_heating_triad.note: v1.4 triad drift members (soft 5 % = plateau precondition; hard 25 % after one transit) + v2.0.3 windowed residual-power hard gate (one-sided, 5 % of the electrode work over the trailing 400000 steps, from the first complete window); the cumulative ratio is recorded as the witness with its 10 % bound as a plateau precondition only. Calibration: the v2 base window ratios were -12.7 % (seed window) rising monotonically to -0.2 % at the plateau (max +0.37 %); seed-b -12.8 -> -1.5 %; w-0.7 -12.7 -> -4.2 %; attempt 8 crossed +5 % at ~3.1 us and reached +54.8 %

stopping_rule.ignition_check: S growing and N_e rising within ~0.5 us at 2e20 / 400 V / 0.6 T is expected (the reference ignited from a seeded column); a non-ignition under the frozen seed and injection is a recorded outcome, not a reason to adjust (comparison-spec inconclusive_conditions)
stopping_rule.plateau: relative drift < 5 % over the trailing 20 % of the elapsed simulated time for the discharge current AND the plasma electron count (linear fit, drift = slope x window / |mean|; the neutral density is static and drops out of the rule), evaluated at every checkpoint; may only be declared after >= 3 ion transit times (3 x 1.40 us = 4.20 us = 6,000,000 steps); additionally the grid-heating triad must be inside its soft bounds AND the window-mode peak-Debye soft margin must hold (<= 2.5) - the ss-v4 rule verbatim
